title: Measuring Similarity between Artistic and AI Generated Images using Siamese Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.28671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-generated art has sparked debates around potential plagiarism, as these images may closely resemble existing artworks. This research quantifies the similarity between original pieces and AI-generated counterparts, particularly those produced by the Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0. We use Siamese Networks with frozen CLIP encoders and cosine similarity optimized through triplet loss. A dataset of paired original and generated images was built using image-to-image generation and custom prompts, enriched with semantic descriptors and BLIP-2 captions. Prior studies report up to 81\% style replication and 90\% visual similarity. Our results show high discriminative performance: training accuracy reached 99.9\%, and the best model configuration achieved 99.4\% test accuracy with strong inter-class separation ($\delta \mu$ = 0.677), demonstrating the effectiveness of our semantic-visual embeddings.

translated_title: 使用孪生神经网络测量艺术图像与AI生成图像之间的相似性
translated_abstract: AI生成的艺术作品引发了关于潜在抄袭的争论，因为这些图像可能与现有艺术作品高度相似。本研究量化了原创作品与AI生成作品之间的相似性，特别是由Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0生成的作品。我们使用带有冻结CLIP编码器的孪生神经网络，并通过三元组损失优化余弦相似度。研究利用图像到图像生成和自定义提示词构建了一个由原始图像和生成图像配对组成的数据集，并通过语义描述符和BLIP-2字幕进行了丰富。此前的研究报告称风格复刻率高达81%，视觉相似度高达90%。我们的结果显示出很高的判别性能：训练准确率达到99.9%，最佳模型配置实现了99.4%的测试准确率，且类间分离度强（δμ = 0.677），证明了我们语义-视觉嵌入方法的有效性。
tldr: 本研究提出使用带有冻结CLIP编码器的孪生神经网络和三元组损失来量化原创艺术作品与AI生成图像之间的相似性，实现了99.4%的测试准确率和良好的类间分离，为AI艺术抄袭检测提供了有效的语义-视觉嵌入方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes Siamese Networks with frozen CLIP encoders optimized via triplet loss to quantify similarity between original artworks and AI-generated images, achieving 99.4% test accuracy with strong inter-class separation, demonstrating effective semantic-visual embeddings for detecting potential AI art plagiarism.
